## Example Sources of Vector Data


- Census Bureau Boundary Shapefiles
- Longitude/Latitude Grids
- Any other territory boundary
- Soils Survey Geographic Database (USDA SSURGO)
- National Hurricane Center Hurricane Paths
- NOAA Severe Weather Data Inventory
- And more!

::: {.notes}
More examples than we can possibly cover today.

We'll focus on the Census Bureau and Soil Survey shapefiles
:::
